schema.title: Standardized Trigger Contract
schema.description: Self-contained HTTP trigger schema. Includes the standard shared trigger fields and the flow-specific field.

id.description: Primary identifier associated with the request.

device.description: Device information related to the request.

schema.x-compatibility-note: Shared and flow-specific trigger fields are fully built into this single schema without external references.

parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Automated flow run record capture.
Flow: @{coalesce(workflow()?['tags']?['flowDisplayName'], workflow()?['name'])}
Run: @{workflow()?['run']?['name']}
Outcome: @{outputs('Compose__Standard_Response_Revised')}

inputs.name: varDurationMs

value.message: Task creation scope failed or timed out.

parameters.emailMessage/Body:
NITDA Verification

Use the code below to complete your verification:

@{variables('varRandomOTP')}

This code expires in 5 minutes.

status.message: @if(less(int(coalesce(variables('varStatusCode'), 500)), 400), 'Completed successfully', if(equals(int(coalesce(variables('varStatusCode'), 500)), 400), 'Bad request', if(equals(int(coalesce(variables('varStatusCode'), 500)), 401), 'Invalid OTP', if(equals(int(coalesce(variables('varStatusCode'), 500)), 404), 'OTP not found', if(equals(int(coalesce(variables('varStatusCode'), 500)), 410), 'OTP expired', 'Failed')))))

request.requestedBy: @if(empty(trim(string(coalesce(triggerBody()?['userEmail'], triggerBody()?['identifier'], triggerBody()?['id'], triggerBody()?['device']?['id'], '')))), 'unknown', trim(string(coalesce(triggerBody()?['userEmail'], triggerBody()?['identifier'], triggerBody()?['id'], triggerBody()?['device']?['id']))))
